purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Sultanganj

queries.query: Sultanganj Bihar official cadastral map parcel land records GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Bhagalpur district land-record link, the Government of Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, and Bihar GIS. The live BhuNaksha viewer exposes Bihar administrative selectors and anonymous REST endpoints.

queries.query: सुल्तानगंज बिहार आधिकारिक भू नक्शा जमीन नक्शा
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery identified BiharBhumi's Hindi land-record gateway and the official Bihar BhuNaksha map portal. The Bhagalpur district land-record page identifies BiharBhumi as the official service.

registryEvidence.custodian: Directorate of Land Records & Survey / Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar; Bhagalpur district administration
registryEvidence.scope: The official Bhagalpur district page directs users to BiharBhumi, and the live Government of Bihar BhuNaksha viewer returned Bhagalpur, Sultanganj circle, and Sultanganj-area mauza selector metadata. This evidences a local/state cadastral map custodian, not open citywide parcel completeness.

officialSources.publisher: Government of Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms / land-record mapping service
officialSources.observation: Live BhuNaksha viewer; HTML and linked JavaScript expose district, subdivision, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance and sheet selectors.
Official district land-record page links to BiharBhumi and identifies the Bhagalpur location.

officialSources.publisher: Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar
officialSources.observation: Official Hindi/English land-record gateway listing Bhu-Manचित्र and related land services.

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified live viewer HTML retrieved; state value 10 and current JavaScript/config entrypoints observed.
Current configuration retrieved; service path is same-origin.

Current JavaScript retrieved; observed rest/Levels/count, rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel, rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, ScalarDatahandler, and WMS routes. No credentials or login used.

Returned Bhagalpur district/subdivision/circle context, Sultanganj circle code 01, 158 mauza entries, and survey choices including Cadastral Survey; observed nearby/local mauza labels include Mirhati, Gangania, Murarpur, Nawada, and others. This was selector metadata, not a parcel response.
Returned null extent fields and a GIS code/attribution for Gangania(77); no usable parcel geometry or parcel ID was returned.
No extent response for the attempted Murarpur route; not treated as parcel absence.
Returned a generic error page rather than WMS capabilities; no CRS or vector schema inferred.

fieldMapping.canonicalId: Not observed in a parcel response
fieldMapping.safeGeometry: Viewer JavaScript references plot selection and map/WMS routes, but no parcel ID-plus-geometry response was returned

parcelDiscovery.compositeKeyProvenance: Administrative selector codes 22/01/01 plus mauza/survey/map-instance routing values were observed only as service parameters; no parcel identity was returned and no synthetic identity was assigned.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bihar state BhuNaksha service with Bhagalpur district and Sultanganj circle/mauza selectors.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Sultanganj administrative selector metadata was returned, but attempted map extent routes did not return usable geometry.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
uncertainty: No parcel ID-plus-geometry response was returned in this attempt.
Null/204 map extent results may reflect unavailable or unpopulated selected map data; they are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

No citywide coverage or adapter qualification was performed.

Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
